metadata.description: Private marketplace of internal development plugins (mobile, backend, ...).

plugins.name: coding-guidelines
plugins.description: Provider-neutral, language-agnostic coding guidelines: how code should be written and commented across any stack.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Provider- and language-neutral agentic workflow: feature/refactor/bugfix playbooks, a fresh-context reviewer subagent, and a deterministic verify gate that blocks turn-end on failing checks.

plugins.name: elixir-dev
plugins.description: Elixir / Phoenix / LiveView / Hologram backend development: stack conventions plus the verify-gate wiring (mix precommit) the dev-workflow plugin enforces.

plugins.name: mobile-dev
plugins.description: Flutter-based iOS & Android app development: skills, code guidelines, and MCP servers.

plugins.name: ui-design
plugins.description: Framework-neutral UI design workflow: design screens in reviewed rounds with Claude Design or Open Design (wireframe, then look, then other sizes), then port the locked mockups into the real app.

plugins.name: roam-dev
plugins.description: Build on roam-sync: E2E-encrypted offline-first sync across a user's own devices (P2P + zero-knowledge relay), LAN pairing, and one-shot nearby sharing.

plugins.name: promo-video
plugins.description: Polished product promo / ad videos for desktop, web and mobile apps: scripted real-app capture, Remotion composition with directed camera and text, beat-synced royalty-free music, and a critic agent that reviews the storyboard and the render. Also narrated devlogs / vlogs with a free offline narrator voice, subtitles and before/after footage.

plugins.name: asset-extract
plugins.description: Get 3D models out of web pages as files: from a Zen/Firefox tab's disk cache without touching the browser (unpacked for Blender, with textures and a preview), or generated on hi3d.ai from an image, saving the GLB its viewer loads.

plugins.name: asset-optimize
plugins.description: Make heavy 3D models game-ready in Blender: triangle-budget variants (decimated with UV seams kept) saved one .blend each, with the original material or an unlit albedo look that shows the texture as painted.

plugins.name: web-games
plugins.description: Publishing games on web portals: the Playgama developer console as an MCP server (games, builds, in-game catalog, sandbox, covers, the Bridge SDK docs and checklist) and a skill that fills Playgama's Add Game form field by field, with the three covers rendered at their exact sizes.
